```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  dpi = 300
)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(
  here, ggplot2, dplyr, scales, cowplot
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
# Source helper functions for model configs
source(here("scripts/R/functions/multi_model_cea.R"))

# Get model configurations
model_configs <- get_model_configs()

# Load PSA cache files for all model structures
all_psa_results <- list()

for (model_name in names(model_configs)) {
  config <- model_configs[[model_name]]
  model_label <- c("joint", "focused", "separate")[config$structure + 1]

  cache_file <- here("data", "tidy", paste0("psa_obj_", model_label, ".rds"))

  if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
    all_psa_results[[model_name]] <- readRDS(cache_file)
    cat("Loaded PSA cache for", model_label, "model\n")
  } else {
    warning("PSA cache not found: ", cache_file)
  }
}

psa_available <- length(all_psa_results) > 0
```

```{r build-scatter-data, include=FALSE}
# Build PSA scatter data for all models
psa_scatter_data <- data.frame()

if (psa_available) {
  for (model_name in names(all_psa_results)) {
    psa_obj <- all_psa_results[[model_name]]
    config <- model_configs[[model_name]]

    if (is.null(psa_obj)) next

    # Extract cost and effect matrices
    cost_df <- as.data.frame(psa_obj$cost)
    effect_df <- as.data.frame(psa_obj$effect)

    for (strategy in psa_obj$strategies) {
      scatter_df <- data.frame(
        Cost = cost_df[[strategy]],
        Effect = effect_df[[strategy]],
        Strategy = strategy,
        Model = config$label,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      psa_scatter_data <- rbind(psa_scatter_data, scatter_df)
    }
  }

  # Create cleaner strategy labels
  strategy_labels <- c(
    "control" = "Control (FLOX only)",
    "crp" = "CRP Strategy",
    "tlr" = "TLR Strategy",
    "tmb_braf" = "TMB/BRAF Strategy"
  )

  psa_scatter_data$Strategy <- factor(
    psa_scatter_data$Strategy,
    levels = names(strategy_labels),
    labels = strategy_labels
  )

  # Order model facets
  psa_scatter_data$Model <- factor(
    psa_scatter_data$Model,
    levels = c("Model A: Joint", "Model B: Focused", "Model C: Separate")
  )
}
```

```{r create-scatter-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
if (nrow(psa_scatter_data) > 0) {
  # Define colors for strategies
  strategy_colors <- c(
    "Control (FLOX only)" = "gray50",
    "CRP Strategy" = "#E69F00",
    "TLR Strategy" = "#009E73",
    "TMB/BRAF Strategy" = "#0072B2"
  )

  p_scatter <- ggplot(psa_scatter_data, aes(x = Effect, y = Cost, color = Strategy)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~Model, ncol = 2) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_currency(prefix = "\u20AC", big.mark = ",")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = strategy_colors, name = "Strategy") +
    labs(
      x = "Effectiveness (QALYs)",
      y = "Total Cost (EUR)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3), nrow = 1))

  print(p_scatter)
} else {
  cat("PSA results not available. Please run script 12_PSA.R first.\n")
}
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
if (nrow(psa_scatter_data) > 0) {
  figs_dir <- here("figs")
  if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) {
    dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  ggsave(
    filename = here("figs", "figure3.png"),
    plot = p_scatter,
    width = 10,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )

  cat("Figure saved to:", here("figs", "figure3.png"), "\n")
}
```

Figure 3 has been saved to `figs/figure3.png`.
